evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt, CI macOS test setup scripts, and Guix build scripts to enforce fatal linker warnings.
rationale: Enforcing fatal linker warnings prevents subtle macOS linker issues from slipping past CI and Guix builds unnoticed. The author notes the intention is to 'Turn linker warnings into errors, so that any future warnings are caught' while deduplicating libraries to silence Apple linker warnings.
